name: odoo
description: Odoo 19.0 (LTS) running on a Heroku container-stack dyno.

ODOO_ADMIN_PASSWD.description: Master password protecting the database manager. Never leave this on Odoo's 'admin' default.

ODOO_INIT_MODULES.description: Modules installed on the very first release, comma separated. 'base' is the bare server; add the apps you need, for example base,l10n_cl,sale_management.

ODOO_UPDATE_MODULES.description: Modules updated on every subsequent release. Leave empty to skip the update; set to 'all' once, after upgrading the Odoo series.

ODOO_LIST_DB.description: Expose the database manager. Keep it False in production.

ODOO_DB_MAXCONN.description: Postgres connections Odoo may open. Must stay below the add-on's connection limit (20 on essential tiers).

ODOO_WORKERS.description: Must stay 0. In multiprocess mode Odoo serves websockets from a second port, which a dyno cannot expose.
